Why repairing can be better than replacing

Save money

A ₹450 charging-port fix beats a ₹15,000 new phone.

Less e-waste

Every repair keeps materials out of landfill a little longer.

Keep what you love

Your broken-in backpack, your favourite cycle — back in action.

Doorstep pickup & delivery

We handle the running around.

FixIt coordinates local delivery partners — we don't own a fleet. Your item's condition and accessories are recorded at pickup, the shop confirms receipt, and you follow every step on a tracking timeline.

  • Handover checklist with condition notes & photos
  • Shop confirms receipt of your item
  • Clear policy for damaged or lost items

In this prototype, drivers and tracking updates are simulated.
